title: Derived lift of the strict ordinary Tate quotient tower
statement: Let T be a Noetherian scheme, ell a prime invertible on T, and d a natural number. There exist an AdicTower M for datum ell, isomorphisms q_n from M.level n to the single complex in degree -2d of quotientLine T ell n d, and h:M.tower=strictDerivedTower T ell d. After q_n inverse, the tower evaluation and h agree exactly with restriction/single followed by the inverse evaluation/single comparison, as in the displayed Lean equation. Use [def-pur-condensed-tate-integral-tower-data] and [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. Neither finite root-tensor identifications nor their scalar-comparison squares are asserted.

source.place: Steps 2--3: K-flatness, strict quotient normalization, and exact evaluation of lem-pur-normalized-tate-tensor-reductions

proof.text: Construct the strict quotient tower with quotient-linear single-complex levels. K-flatness of the locally free integral root tensor makes ordinary quotient balancing compute the derived reductions, including equal indices and the zeroth tensor power. This supplies the tower, level isomorphisms and strict tower equality.

Apply the evaluation-normalization theorem to the tower, its initial level identifications and its strict tower equality. It supplies corrected level identifications q′_n satisfying the exact restriction/single and evaluation/single equation. Choose these q′_n as the witnesses in the unchanged existential lift theorem.

proof_origin.place: Steps 2--3: construct tower data, then choose evaluation-normalized level identifications

lean.statement:
theorem strictTateTensorTower_lift
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    (hT : IsUnit (ell : Γ(T, ⊤))) (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ (M : AdicTower T (datum.{u} ell))
      (q : ∀ n : ℕ, M.level n ≅
        (_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ (-(2 * (d : ℤ)))).obj
          (quotientLine T ell n d))
      (h : M.tower = strictDerivedTower T ell d),
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        (pbcDerivedRestrict (pbcAdicProjection T (datum.{u} ell) n)).map (q n).inv ≫
            (M.evaluation n).hom ≫
            (pbcTowerEvaluation T (pbcAdicCompletion T (datum.{u} ell)) n).map
              (eqToHom h) =
          (Functor.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor
            (pbcRestrict (pbcAdicProjection T (datum.{u} ell) n))
            (-(2 * (d : ℤ)))).hom.app (quotientLine T ell n d) ≫
          (Functor.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor
            ((CategoryTheory.evaluation ℕᵒᵖ
              (pbcModules T (pbcAdicCompletion T (datum.{u} ell)))).obj (op n))
            (-(2 * (d : ℤ)))).inv.app (strictTower T ell d)
